name: Mutsu (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Mutsu city emblem in white: a stylised device of two rings and a leaf-like shape.
history: Municipal flag of Mutsu, a city in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 19 December 2008; the emblem dates from 1 November 1960.

features.role: Mutsu city emblem — a stylised device of two rings and a leaf-like shape
